negatives.failure_signature: The JavaScript orchestration parser rejected a PowerShell rewrite command because PowerShell backtick-newline tokens terminated the outer template literal.
negatives.recovery: Retained the parser failure and changed to an apply-patch block deletion without layered command-language newline escapes.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not embed PowerShell backtick escapes in a JavaScript template literal; use apply-patch or a single-language file transformation.
negatives.promotion_effect: none; the failed orchestration script made no shell call and changed no file

negatives.surface: combined login-shell inspection and compilation probe
negatives.failure: The combined probe reached its 20-second bound before returning any complete child output.
negatives.impact: No file or repository conclusion was drawn from the timed-out parent command.
negatives.workaround: Repeat only the required surfaces as non-login commands with independent bounds; the file-presence and compilation probes then completed.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not combine shell startup, filesystem enumeration, Git status, and compilation under one short parent envelope on this checkout.
negatives.rollback: Retain the timeout, treat the combined receipt as no evidence, and make no mutation before the bounded retries complete.
negatives.sibling_recommendation: Use independently bounded non-login probes for this checkout when the combined startup surface has already timed out.

negatives.failure: An unquoted HEAD...@{upstream} token was transformed by PowerShell before Git received it, so the trailing rev-list probe failed after the evidence commit and push had already succeeded.
negatives.impact: The commit and remote update remained successful, but that combined command did not establish divergence equality.
negatives.workaround: Pass the upstream revision expression as a single-quoted literal and independently resolve local, upstream, tracking, and live-remote hashes.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Quote Git revision expressions containing @{...} in PowerShell or resolve them to hashes before composition.
negatives.rollback: Retain the failed probe, make no equality claim from it, and rerun only read-only resolution and divergence checks.
negatives.sibling_recommendation: Use a literal 'HEAD...@{upstream}' argument on PowerShell when checking divergence.

negatives.failure: PowerShell rejected a parenthesized assignment that mixed a Git command and an if statement, before any replay child command executed.
negatives.impact: No scoped test, validator, manifest, ancestry, or cleanliness result was produced or counted by the failed replay start.
negatives.workaround: Run each Git ancestry command as its own statement, capture LASTEXITCODE immediately, and construct the summary object only after all commands complete.
negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not embed statement lists inside a PowerShell assignment expression; separate command execution, exit-code capture, and object construction.
negatives.rollback: Retain the parser failure, award no replay evidence, keep the named lane unchanged, and retry only after validating the corrected transport pattern read-only.
negatives.sibling_recommendation: Capture PowerShell native-command exit codes in separate statements before composing a JSON receipt.

retention_rule: Recovery never erases a failure; later evidence may reference only the corrected complete operation.
